parts.text: How much bereavement leave can I take?

You can take up to 4 weeks of paid bereavement leave per event. Leave is counted in work days against your regular schedule, so on a standard 40-hour, 5-day week that is up to 20 work days. The 4 weeks are inclusive of all local statutory leave requirements, and the leave must be taken within 12 months of the death, with exceptions possible where religious, spiritual or cultural rites happen later. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/22-bereavement-leave-global/22.2-allowance-and-timelines.md

property.description: States 4 weeks, and 20 work days on a standard 5-day schedule.
States the 12-month window from the death.
Does not state a figure such as 3 or 5 days.

parts.text: My dog died yesterday. Can I take bereavement leave?

I'm sorry. Paid bereavement leave does not apply to the loss of a pet or animal companion. You can work with your manager to arrange vacation, unpaid time off, or a temporary flexible working schedule instead. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/22-bereavement-leave-global/22.1-general-scope-and-eligibility.md

property.description: States that bereavement leave does not cover pet loss.

parts.text: How many vacation days do I get per year?

You earn your full allotment for the year on 1 January, and the amount depends on continuous service: 20 days for 1 to 6 years, 21 days for 7 to 10 years, and 22 days from 11 years. Your first year is prorated from your start date, and part-time or fixed-term employees accrue pro rata against their working schedule or FTE. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/20-vacation-leave-singapore/20.2-accrual-rates-and-increments.md

property.description: Gives all three tiers: 20, 21 and 22 days with matching service bands.

parts.text: What happens to vacation days I don't use this year?

Unused vacation carries over for exactly one additional year and must be used before the end of that following year, otherwise you lose it. The company does not cash out unused vacation; the only exceptions are transferring to another country or leaving the company. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/20-vacation-leave-singapore/20.3-carryover-and-payouts.md

property.description: States carry-over is exactly one additional year and then expires.
States there is no cash-out, with the transfer or leaving exception.

parts.text: How much sick leave do I have?

Singapore-based employees get up to 14 days of paid outpatient sick leave per year at 100% of base salary. Separately there are an additional 46 work days of hospitalization leave, which is discretionary, granted case by case, and requires you to contact support and meet one of the qualifying conditions such as being warded as an inpatient or being under quarantine. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/19-sick-time-hospitalization-leave-singapore/19.2-outpatient-sick-leave.md, gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/19-sick-time-hospitalization-leave-singapore/19.3-hospitalization-leave.md

property.description: States 14 days of outpatient sick leave.

parts.text: Do I need a medical certificate if I'm off sick?

You need one if you are sick for more than two work days. The certificate must come from a registered medical practitioner and be submitted through WorkWeek within 48 hours; the company can decline the sick leave if it is not. Separately, you must tell your manager at least one hour before your normal start time. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/19-sick-time-hospitalization-leave-singapore/19.4-notification-and-medical-certificates-mc.md

property.description: States the threshold is more than two work days.
States the 48-hour submission window through WorkWeek.

parts.text: My mother is seriously ill. What leave can I take to care for her?

Carer's leave covers this. You can take up to 8 weeks of paid leave per loved one per lifetime for a serious or terminal illness. It can be taken in weekly blocks or as daily schedules with a minimum of half a work day, and it is prorated if you are part-time. Speak to your manager first, then you or your manager contacts support with the dates and your relationship to the person. Do not include any medical information when you contact support. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/23-carers-leave-global/23.2-leave-allowance-and-increments.md, gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/23-carers-leave-global/23.3-attestation-and-requesting-leave.md

property.description: States 8 weeks per loved one per lifetime.

parts.text: I have a 5-year-old and a 9-year-old. How many childcare leave days do I get?

Six days. Childcare leave is 6 paid days a year if you have children under 7, and 2 days if your youngest is between 7 and 12. Where you have children in both bands, as you do, the entitlement is 6 days. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/24-childcare-leave-singapore/24.2-leave-allowance.md

parts.text: How long is baby bonding leave and when do I have to use it?

Up to 18 weeks, which is 90 work days, at full pay, inclusive of local statutory entitlements such as statutory paternity leave. Leave can start on or after the birth, adoption or foster placement date, and all 18 weeks must be used within 12 months of that date or the remainder is lost. Multiple children at the same time still give one 18-week period. Give your manager at least 4 weeks of notice where possible. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/26-baby-bonding-leave-global/26.2-leave-allowance-and-timelines.md, gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/26-baby-bonding-leave-global/26.4-requesting-and-modifying-leave.md

property.description: States 18 weeks or 90 work days.
States the 12-month use-by window and that the remainder is lost.

parts.text: Am I eligible for ramp-back time after 8 weeks of baby bonding leave?

No. Ramp-back time requires at least 10 consecutive weeks of maternity, adoption, parental or baby bonding leave, and 8 weeks does not meet that. If you do qualify, ramp-back is up to 2 weeks at 100% of your normal salary while working a minimum of 50% of your normal weekly hours, and it must be taken in the first 2 weeks of your return. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/28-ramp-back-time-global/28.1-purpose-and-eligibility.md, gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/28-ramp-back-time-global/28.2-schedule-and-duration.md

parts.text: What's the meal limit when I travel for work?

Meals are capped at US$120 per employee per day, and the same cap applies to group meals with colleagues. It is not a per diem: every meal has to be itemised with receipts. For group meals you list all attending colleagues in Concur, and the most senior person present pays and submits the expense. Any group meal or customer entertainment costing US$500 or more per head needs written VP approval before the event. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/04-travel-expense-te-guidelines/4.4-meal-allowances-entertainment.md

property.description: States US$120 per employee per day.

parts.text: I forgot to expense a hotel from four months ago. Can I still claim it?

Yes, but it needs escalated approval. Expenses are normally due in Concur within 30 days of the transaction or travel end date. Out-of-pocket claims older than 60 days require Director approval and claims older than 90 days require VP approval, which at four months is where yours falls. The approval has to come from someone higher up the chain than your immediate manager. Claims older than one year are not reimbursable at all. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/04-travel-expense-te-guidelines/4.2-corporate-cards-company-card-expense-submission.md

property.description: Identifies VP approval as the requirement at four months.
